decisions.quote: This paper presents a conceptual replication of a previous experimental study that evaluated two practices associated with source code readability, namely, use of comments and method chaining. The replication study has the same research questions as the original study and involved almost all students of an OOP course of an informatics engineering program.
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files were checked and are absent for this never-adjudicated work. The supplied primary source (10.1109/iccq60895.2024.10576941) is abstract-only. It explicitly describes an empirical conceptual replication re-testing perceived readability and comprehension across method-chaining and comment variants and contrasts its findings with the original study, but it provides no authors, year, title, DOI, or reference entry for the replicated study. Shipped row 1853 (Borstler & Paech, 2016, 'The Role of Method Chains and Comments in Software Readability and Comprehension—An Experiment', 10.1109/tse.2016.2527791, verified in Crossref metadata) matches the experimental factors and outcome measures, but without the primary full text or reference list, actual primary evidence does not settle the exact bibliographic identity of the target original or prove whether it is identical to shipped row 1853.
